curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Separate errors that lower the score from automatic failures, then teach the seven-day and two-month retake waits.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each group of scored errors and automatic failures; contrast cards for the ordinary retake versus the third failure.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described mistake costs points or fails the exam, and when a retake is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why an adult signs for a minor, who may sign in order, what signing means, and what happens when the signer withdraws.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per liability rule; contrast card for the adult signature versus the DCS insurance route.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who signs and the effect of a withdrawal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk the license checklist: age with or without driver education, the permit holding period, supervised practice hours and the log, and the disability route.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Threshold cards for ages, days and hours; contrast cards for with versus without driver education and under versus over eighteen.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described applicant is ready to apply.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach probationary validity, then the first-period passenger and night limits, the later under-eighteen hours, the exceptions, and school-related suspensions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each limit and exception; contrast cards for the first period versus the later period.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described probationary trip is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover license validity by age, commercial license ages and scope, how credentials are delivered, photo exemptions, then the seat belt and phone laws.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for validity bands, commercial ages, delivery and safety laws; contrast cards for probationary versus all-driver phone rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on validity periods, delivery and phone and seat belt rules.
